translations.web: See how good and how pleasant it is for brothers to live together in unity!
translations.bsb: Behold, how good and pleasant it is when brothers live together in harmony!
translations.kjv: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!
translations.asv: Behold, how good and how pleasant it is For brethren to dwell together in unity!
